title: Finite split additive series of group schemes
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $U$ a $k$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. A split additive series of length $n\geq0$ is defined recursively. For $n=0$, $U$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] and isomorphic to the trivial group scheme. For $n=m+1$, $U$ is smooth and connected, and there are a closed normal subgroup inclusion $i:N\to U$ [def-sc-group-scheme-subgroup] and a homomorphism $q:U\to\mathbf G_a$ [def-sc-gm-ga] which represents the fppf quotient by $N$ [def-sfb-solvable-group-structure], such that $N$ has a split additive series of length $m$. Thus $U=U_0\supseteq\cdots\supseteq U_n=1$ has smooth connected terms, each successor closed and normal in its predecessor, and each successive represented quotient is $\mathbf G_a$. Existence of such a series is splitness for a unipotent group.
